text: Appeal of Order to Comply for 33 Thirteenth Street

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated November 1, 2019, regarding the property located at 33 Thirteenth Street, Folder No. 19 242282 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to January 28, 2021.
